lockFileMaintenance.description: Most of package-lock.json and much of Gemfile.lock are packages nothing names directly, such as webpack's and Sinatra's own dependencies. Renovate only moves those when a named package asks for it, so the locks are rebuilt once a month to keep them current as well

packageRules.description: The client is written against Mithril 0.2 (m.component, controller and view), and Mithril 1 and later changed that API, so a major update is a rewrite of every view rather than a version bump
The markup and the bundled bootstrap.min.css are Bootstrap 3 (glyphicons, col-xs-*), and Bootstrap 3's plugins need jQuery 1.9 to 3. Bootstrap and jQuery move as a pair, and only within those majors
See the Bootstrap rule: Bootstrap 3's plugins do not support jQuery 4
The viewer uses PhotoSwipe 4's constructor and its default UI, which PhotoSwipe 5 replaced with a different API

Workflows are already read by the github-actions manager. Grouping them keeps a handful of actions from arriving as a handful of pull requests, since they are updated together and reviewed the same way
